headline: Sleep debt is the story today (25h banked, TSB -14.6) — bike class banked easy, then the speed reps if legs feel sharp.
body_state: Readiness composite 76.8/green (driven by TSB, not HRV), but the overtraining scan flags one red item: **sleep_debt** — 25h of 14-day debt despite last night's solid 8.5h (30,681s) and sleep score 85. HRV 47ms is BALANCED, resting HR normal, stress avg 14 (low). Body Battery only 40 this morning though, and ACWR sits at 1.13 (sweet-spot, not overreaching). Net: the engine says you *can* train, but the sleep ledger says be deliberate about what kind.
training: Two sessions today: **45min indoor cycling** (booked, unrated intensity — keep it Z2-ish given the sleep debt) and **10 x 200m Speed Reps** from the plan (10min easy warm-up @ 4:51-5:20/km, 10x200m @ 3:42-3:58/km w/ 60s walk recovery, 10min cooldown @ 4:51-5:20/km, cadence target 174). Neither is done yet. Order matters: bike first as the aerobic leg, reps second only if legs feel genuinely fresh — these are short and fast, not a fatigue test, so if the bike leaves you flat, swap the reps for easy running instead and don't force the neuromuscular work on tired sleep.
recent: Pattern the last 3 days: intensity keeps landing on days it shouldn't. Aug 15's Un1t class ran 23min at Z4-Z5 and pushed into Z6 (TE 3.0/2.6) on a red-flagged readiness morning — logged RPE 7. Aug 14's "easy" 7km run negative-split into a 4:28/km, HR 159-166 close (RPE 6) against a 4:51-5:20/km target, cadence still stuck at 159spm vs the 168-172 target — the overstriding pattern from stride length, not turnover. Insights confirm the trend: only 20% easy running vs the 80% polarised target this block. The through-line: pace/effort discipline on nominally easy days, not fitness, is the current limiter.
focus: Cap the bike class at Z2-Z3 — the sleep-debt flag applies to the whole day's load, not just the run
On the 200s: hold warm-up/cooldown pace by the numbers (4:51-5:20/km), not by feel — that's where recent easy days have leaked fast
Lift cadence toward 168-172 spm, especially late in any effort when stride length wants to do the work instead
